statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-49272 (GHSA-3jp2-3mrg-2vxc): OAuthLib: Bearer token can be retrieved as long as client knows a valid client ID for device workflow. Upstream fixed it in oauthlib 4.0.1 (https://github.com/oauthlib/oauthlib/releases/tag/v4.0.1, https://github.com/oauthlib/oauthlib/security/advisories/GHSA-3jp2-3mrg-2vxc, https://github.com/oauthlib/oauthlib/commit/77a5f1c8ce00da2b0b8c5f6e9cc129920085f114, https://github.com/oauthlib/oauthlib/pull/954, https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-3jp2-3mrg-2vxc). k8s-sidecar is a Python application installed in a virtual environment with its dependencies. Checked every published k8s-sidecar package for Alpine 3.24 in the DHI Alpine repository, 2.10.1-r0 to the current 2.14.3-r5, x86_64 and aarch64, reading the oauthlib version from its .dist-info metadata in each build: every build from 2.10.1-r0 to 2.14.3-r2 ships oauthlib 3.3.1 or 4.0.0, and every build from 2.14.3-r3 to 2.14.3-r5 ships oauthlib 4.0.1. The range ends at 2.14.3-r3.
